title: Coastal Soul Residence | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upstairs, the bedrooms offer luxurious accommodations with king beds and smart TVs in the first two rooms, while the third bedroom boasts two bunk beds, perfect for children or additional guests. The master bedroom features an en suite bathroom, while the second bathroom includes a tub/shower combo. With free Wi-Fi and the ability to sleep up to ten guests, this home is perfect for families or groups seeking a memorable getaway. Enjoy the 17-mile bike path and the ease of walking or biking everywhere, making this rental an ideal choice for your next vacation. This three-bedroom haven, is complete with a golf cart and four bikes. The home features a large living area with a smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, and a dedicated dining area, all designed for comfort and relaxation. The main level includes a half bathroom and a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer, ensuring convenience during your stay.
